footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. Other items, net are gains and charges StockAnalysis lists below the operating line (−$1.0M in 2025). From pre-tax income to net income to common: after income tax and $900K of preferred dividends & other. Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from StockAnalysis (S&P Global Market Intelligence data) for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier. Never estimated: items not reported there are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services is the holding company for Burke & Herbert Bank & Trust Company, which provides banking services to individuals and businesses. Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) rose 32.2% to $340M in 2025. Net interest income rose 30.5% to $296M and noninterest income rose 44.4% to $44.1M; noninterest expense rose 9.3%, and the provision for credit losses was $1.5M, versus $24.2M.
Net income to common rose 3.3× to $116M, or $7.72 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 56.6% versus 68.5%. Burke & Herbert Financial Services returned $33.0M through dividends.
highlights: Net income to common rose 3.3× to $116M.
